title: Write Strobe Zero Causes Silent No-Op
description: When WSTRB=4'b0000, the crossbar executes a write to the slave without any byte enables, writing nothing but generating a successful BRESP, masking a missing strobe error.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_DATA] WSTRB=0 accepted; no data written but BVALID asserted
expected_root_cause: The WSTRB validity check is absent; the protocol requires at least one strobe bit to be set for a valid write transfer [1, 4].
failure_log:
WSTRB=4'b0000, WVALID=1. BRESP=OKAY. RAM unchanged.
UVM_ERROR: Illegal no-op write accepted.
success_log: WSTRB=0 generates SLVERR or is rejected before write occurs.
rtl: always_ff @(posedge clk) if (wvalid && wready) mem[addr] <= wdata;
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) if (wvalid && wready && |wstrb) begin foreach(wstrb[i]) if (wstrb[i]) mem[addr][i*8+:8] <= wdata[i*8+:8]; end
